result.summary: Extracts Guix cross-compilation toolchain definitions from manifest_build.scm into a dedicated toolchains.scm module, making them reusable across manifests. Introduces a separate linux_static.scm manifest used during Linux builds in guix-build, and adds the cross-toolchain to manifest_gui.scm. Updates guix-build to configure GUIX_PACKAGE_PATH so Guix can locate the new local module and patch files.
result.problem: Linux toolchain definitions were embedded directly inside manifest_build.scm, preventing developers from configuring alternate toolchains or building separate static environments independently.
evidence: PR description: 'This is a prerequisite for static release builds (#25573). A split toolchain also allows us to make other builds changes, like #36193 (building a more stripped down libstdc++, and shipping smaller binaries).'
result.scope_notes: Refactoring Guix Scheme files and build scripts without changing the compiler versions or flags used.
result.changed_since_previous: Rebased without substantive changes to the approach or the resulting Guix module split.
result.card: Extracts Guix cross-compilation toolchains from manifest_build.scm into a standalone toolchains.scm module and introduces a linux_static.scm manifest. This unblocks producing static release builds (#25573) and enabling stripped-down libstdc++ builds for smaller binaries (#36193). Changes are restricted to Guix build configuration and environment setup.

risk.why: Flaws in Guix build manifests or module paths could break release binary builds or deterministic reproducibility on Linux targets.
